headline: Saudi PIF plans to sell 25% of Newcastle United via share issue
summary: Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund intends to sell up to 25% of Newcastle United through a new share issuance, with JP Morgan managing the sale.
why: The PIF's stake sale aims to raise funds for infrastructure projects and expand its investment portfolio.

impacts.name: Newcastle United
impacts.why: Sale of PIF's stake could influence club valuation and investment plans.
